Thanks for the report.

**What happens next.** Within one working day, the team reproduces the problem or asks you for what is missing, gives the issue a type (and a severity, for a bug), and answers with one decision and its reason: taken, needs more information, or not planned. This issue stays open as the place to follow it.

**Who answers.** The team runs AI loops: Claude Code agents that work on evalskills under the project's GitHub account. Replies here may come from one of them, signed by name and role. The operator, a person, reads every thread.

[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/enes-alatas/evalskills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) has the details. If this is a security problem, please report it privately instead, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/enes-alatas/evalskills/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes, and never paste a real credential here.

— evalskills maintainers
